name: Northstar Health — controlled substance waste
note: Ground truth declared when the corpus was authored, before any analysis code existed. It tests whether the pipeline finds what was deliberately placed there and, more importantly, declines to find what was deliberately placed to mislead it.
honesty: This is a planted-finding suite: it exercises the mechanics end to end but cannot show that the system works on knowledge nobody designed for it. The Joint Commission coverage gold set (eval/gold.json) is the harder test, on real documents.

extraction.description: Each document yields its own published units, and every span must verify byte-for-byte.

roles.description: Lifecycle role comes from the document's declared type, not from inference.

change_detection.description: Version 1 to version 2 of the standard.

added_contains: who did not administer the dose

conflicts.description: Organizational statements that cannot both be followed alongside the new requirement.

expected.why: permits the administering nurse to witness; the requirement forbids it
documents waste by end of shift; the requirement forbids retrospective entry

expected.organizational: Controlled Substance Safety — Annual Education Module §3

gaps.description: Requirements with no organizational knowledge providing what they demand.

expected.why: newly added quarterly audit and reporting; nothing in the corpus establishes either

gaps.allowed_additional_note: Both are defensible: no supplied document governs the return of controlled substances, and the education module is annual with nothing establishing delivery at orientation. Neither is required for a pass.

decoys.description: Documents placed to be attractive to a lexical matcher and wrong for a reader.

must_not_relate.document: Sharps and Regulated Waste Disposal Procedure
must_not_relate.why: shares the word 'waste' throughout, but means regulated medical waste, not controlled substance waste
shares 'controlled substance' and 'count', but governs vault inventory rather than waste or reconciliation timeframes

citations.description: Every piece of evidence must be a real span of the document it cites.

effective_dates.description: A superseded version stays in the graph but must never be answered with.

source_authority.description: Provenance must survive ingestion; a finding whose source has no authority cannot be weighed.
